name: Get A Grip [BETA]
desc:
Explore the vibrant streets of Redcliff City using our unique climbing mechanics! Scale buildings, discover hidden spots, use the public transport system to travel across town, visit surrounding villages, and explore iconic landmarks.

Whether you're looking for an interactive climbing sandbox, dynamic ragdoll physics, or a realistic roleplay experience, our expansive open-world offers endless possibilities!

Game Features:

Dynamic Climbing System: Traverse urban environments and obstacles with complete freedom.

Public Transit Network: Ride trams and trains to travel between cities and landmarks.

Vast Open World: Explore diverse towns, countryside locations, and secret areas.

Flexible Gameplay: Perfect for casual physics fun, exploration, or immersive roleplay.

Credits: @prOFFix51 (scripting help), @ostra_sklzavka (artwork for the game), @Lordof_Smiler (helping with building assets)

Inspired by:  Retrograd, and Ragdoll Engine.
